# Digital Technology Partner: public information

> This file expands DTP's concise [llms.txt](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/llms.txt) with public detail and authoritative links. It contains descriptions from DTP's own website, not independent validation of DTP's outcomes.

## Organisation

Digital Technology Partner (DTP) presents itself as helping leadership teams turn scattered AI activity into governed systems intended to create measurable operational value. Its public contact page says it operates from Aberdeen and works remotely.

- [DTP home](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/home/)
- [Why DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/why-dtp/)
- [Contact DTP](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/contact/)

## Public programmes

### AI Adoption Readiness Sprint

DTP describes this as a one-week assessment of current AI use, risk, noise and opportunity.

- [AI Adoption Readiness Sprint](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-adoption-readiness/)

### AI Foundry

DTP describes AI Foundry as a twelve-week working group that turns experiments into evidence and leadership decisions. The page explicitly distinguishes it from a conventional course.

- [AI Foundry](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/ai-foundry/)

### Leadership AI Coaching

DTP describes this as confidential, private and one-to-one coaching for senior leaders.

- [Leadership AI Coaching](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/leadership-ai-coaching/)

- [All AI programmes](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/programmes/)

## Delivery process

DTP describes a five-gate method: Discover, Prove, Build, Pilot and Launch. Its process page says there is a right to stop at every gate.

- [DTP process](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/process/)

## Solutions

DTP says it designs and builds dashboards, workflow automation, AI agents and bespoke AI or business systems around workflow, data, people and governance.

- [DTP solutions](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/solutions/)

## Products

### WhichLogin

DTP presents WhichLogin as a local-only macOS menu-bar app that records sign-in routes on the user's Mac. Its privacy page says the data is stored locally.

- [WhichLogin](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/apps/whichlogin/)
- [WhichLogin privacy policy](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/apps/whichlogin/privacy-policy/)
- [WhichLogin support](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/apps/whichlogin/support/)

### 10 Touches

The 10 Touches privacy policy describes it as a personal CRM whose production data stays locally on the device.

- [10 Touches privacy policy](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/10-touches/privacy/)
- [10 Touches TestFlight beta privacy policy](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/10-touches/privacy/beta/)

## Publications

DTP publishes a newsroom about AI adoption, governance, delivery and automation. Article titles below are links to DTP's published commentary. Titles and third-party figures appearing in them are not claims about DTP.

- [Insights](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/insights/)
- [Newsroom](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/)
- [Newsroom archive](https://digitaltechnologypartner.ai/news/archive/)
